notes.title: UPDATE #5
notes.content:
The new location is ready for exploration.
In this abandoned place you will find a lot of different loot and dangerous creatures. (loot is only available in the new game)

Various bugs have also been fixed:


 Various bugs with animals have been fixed.
 Fixed a bug with growing vegetables.
 Fixed a bug with disappearing textures

notes.title: New update - Caves
notes.content:
New update - Caves.


 An early version of the caves is ready for exploration. Here you can find some new resources and fight underground creatures.
 The dungeon will be constantly expanded with the new update. In the first version there will be only 1 entrance and exit from the cave.
 The storyline will be closely related to the dungeon.


IMPORTANT: ERROR IN THE CAVE WITH SAVING!!!
Before entering the cave, save the game in a new slot! Otherwise, if you die inside the cave, you will lose all your houses and things! I will look into this error!
